items.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, like Sidney Bechet was sort of the king of that, I think, going to France. [INTERVIEWEE] Yup.

ctx.x: Oh absolutely. They had a chance to play more in the well known Montmarte in the case of Copenhagen you know, and just appreciated. You know they were loved by the localities where they lived you know, treated as high artists.
